parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: Name of the task that produced the result.

parameters.name: ScheduleName
parameters.description: Name of the schedule that produced the result.

parameters.name: ActionName
parameters.description: Name of the action that produced the result.

parameters.name: EventTime
parameters.description: The date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the event that triggered the schedule of the action that produced the reported result values in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the action started in UTC.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, that the action was completed in UTC.

parameters.name: CycleNumber
parameters.description: The cycle number derived from the {{param|EventTime}}. The cycle number is the time, in UTC, closest to the {{param|EventTime}} that is a multiple of the cycle interval of the event that triggered the execution of the schedule. The value is valid if the event that triggered the execution of the schedule has a defined cycle interval. {{empty}} represents an invalid CycleNumber. {{pattern}}

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status code returned by the execution of the action.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: {{list|each entry represents tags defined for the schedule, task and action objects that produced this result}}

object.description: The {{object}} object provides the meta-data of the result report of a single executed action that produced the result.
